Name: Black cat instead of grey
Author: YaGirlVTheGamer
Description:
Hello and welcome to my first mod!

I decided to do something simple and turn the grey tabby cat into a black cat with bright green eyes!

This mod requires the use of Content Patcher by Pathoschild which you can find [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]here
[/url]
[size=4]Installation
[list]
[*]Download and install SMAPI (You can find it [url=https://smapi.io/]here[/url])
[*]Install Content Patcher
[*]Extract [CP]BlackCat.zip to StadewValley\mods﻿
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list][/size]Congrats! You should notice it in the character creation screen when trying to select the grey cat.﻿


[size=4]Changelog: 1/1/2022
